p.UNDIFFERENTIATED-PILE-OF-MARKDOWN-ROTS: One undifferentiated pile of markdown rots: contracts bloat with narrative, narrative gets treated as binding, and nobody knows what wins.

p.EVERY-DOCUMENT-BELONGS-TO-EXACTLY-ONE-GE: Every document belongs to exactly one genre; the genre decides where it lives, how it may change, and what authority it carries.

p.full-charters-pointer: Full charters, mutability rules, and conflict authority: @spec://org.vibevm.world/spec-genres/flows/spec-genres/SPEC-GENRES-PROTOCOL#root.

p.NAME-THE-GENRE-BEFORE-WRITING-ANY-DOCUME: **Before writing any project document, name its genre first.** Then:

item.CONTRACT-WINS-OVER-LORE: **Contract wins over lore.** When a design document and the contract it explains disagree, the contract wins and the design document is corrected — lore never silently diverges.

item.KEEP-THE-TWO-WAY-LINKS: **Keep the two-way links.** A contract section that has lore links to it; the lore names the section it explains. A cold reader entering from either side finds the other.

why.title: Why this matters in a human-AI team

p.AGENT-READS-THE-TREE-COLD-EVERY-SESSION: The agent reads the tree cold every session.

p.look-alike-prose-gets-implemented-or-sof: If binding and non-binding prose look alike, it will implement a parked idea out of a design doc, or soften a contract because the narrative around it sounded tentative.

p.GENRE-TYPING-ASSIGNS-AUTHORITY-WITHOUT-A: Genre typing is what lets a cold reader assign authority to a sentence without asking anyone.

item.NEVER-PUT-NORMATIVE-LANGUAGE-IN-A-DESIGN: Never put normative language — "must", "shall", requirement lists — in a design doc. Extract it to the contract; link back.

item.NEVER-EDIT-THE-CONTRACT-TO-MATCH-THE-LOR: Never resolve a contract-vs-lore conflict by editing the contract to match the lore. The correction runs the other way.

item.NEVER-CREATE-A-DOCUMENT-WITHOUT-DECIDING: Never create a document without deciding its genre.

item.NEVER-LET-LORE-GO-UNLINKED-FROM-ITS-CONT: Never let lore go unlinked from its contract — an unlinked design doc is invisible at the next cold start.
